title: 我的一天

explanations.1: Indicates the action of getting up in the morning.
explanations.2: Modal verb expressing ability, here used with 不 to mean 'cannot'.
explanations.3: Connects the reason (不能迟到) and the result (很快去洗脸).
explanations.4: Degree adverb modifying 快 to mean 'very quickly'.
explanations.5: Noun meaning breakfast, object of 吃.
explanations.6: Interrogative pronoun used in 不知道 to ask about the thing he doesn't know.
explanations.7: Dynamic particle marking completion of the action 给.
explanations.8: Conjunction linking 面包 and 牛奶.
explanations.9: Degree adverb meaning 'really', modifying 好吃.
explanations.10: Measure word for cup/drink, used with 一.
explanations.11: Measure word for piece/lump, used with 一 for bread.
explanations.13: Location noun meaning 'on', indicating position on the bus.
explanations.14: Time adverb indicating an action in progress.
explanations.15: Adverb meaning 'also', showing the teacher also speaks Chinese.

translation: Today morning, I got up at seven. I cannot be late, so I quickly went to the bathroom to wash my face. Then I ate breakfast. I didn't know what to eat, so Mom gave me bread and milk, it was really delicious. I drank a glass of milk and ate a piece of bread. At eight, I walked to school together with my friend. We sat on the bus. In front of the school, we met this teacher. At school, we were having Chinese class. In the classroom, we can speak Chinese, and the teacher can also speak Chinese. At noon, we all ate lunch in the dining hall. In the afternoon, we went home. In the evening, I did my homework first, then watched TV. At ten, I went to sleep.
